item.description: ### Fixed - **Lock-screen cards are no longer started on phones that have gone quiet.** Perch could start a Live Activity on an iPhone it had not heard from in up to two weeks, such as an old install or a test device. iOS allows only a handful of these starts, so the wasted ones could leave your real phone without a card. Perch now starts a card only on a phone it has seen in the last two days, or one that is connected right now. Alerts still reach a phone that has been away for up to two weeks.
